data.name: AccountNotFound
data.value: This account could not be found.

data.name: AccountNameTaken
data.value: This account name is already taken.

data.name: AccountNameInvalid
data.value: This account name is not valid. Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter.

data.name: AccountNameReserved
data.value: This account name is reserved for the system and cannot be used. Choose another name.

data.name: AccountDomainTaken
data.value: This domain is already used by another account.

data.name: AccountDomainWwwPrefix
data.value: Enter the primary domain without "www.", for example example.com.

data.name: AccountOwnerLanguageUnsupported
data.value: Choose the owner's language from the list: English, Russian or Armenian.

data.name: PlanNotFound
data.value: This plan could not be found.

data.name: PlanNameTaken
data.value: Another plan already has this name.

data.name: PlanInUse
data.value: This plan was not deleted: accounts are still on it. Move those accounts to another plan or delete them first.

data.name: PlanQuotaBelowUsage
data.value: The plan was not changed: an account on it already uses more disk than the new quota allows, and lowering the quota would stop that account from writing files. Raise the quota, or free space or move that account to another plan first.

data.name: AccountPlanQuotaBelowUsage
data.value: The plan was not changed: this account already uses more disk than the new plan's quota allows, and moving it would stop it from writing files. Choose a plan with a larger quota, or free space on the account first.

data.name: AccountCleanupFailed
data.value: The account was not deleted: something it owns could not be removed first. Nothing has been changed; please try again.

data.name: AccountLoginIssuanceFailed
data.value: The account was created, but the login for its owner could not be issued. Do not create the account again; resend the invitation instead.

data.name: AccountSuspensionFailed
data.value: The account was not suspended: something it runs could not be stopped first. Nothing has been changed; please try again.

data.name: AccountSuspensionNotObserved
data.value: The account was not suspended: the server could not be observed to have stopped it. Nothing has been changed; please try again.

data.name: AccountResumptionFailed
data.value: The account was not reactivated: something it runs could not be started again. Nothing has been changed; please try again.

data.name: AccountResumptionNotObserved
data.value: The account was not reactivated: the server could not be observed to have started it again. Nothing has been changed; please try again.

data.name: AccountHomeGroupRepairPlanChanged
data.value: The host's home directories no longer match the report you read, so nothing was repaired and nothing was changed. Read a fresh report and confirm its figures before repairing.

data.name: AccountHomeGroupRepairCountInvalid
data.value: The number of homes to repair cannot be negative. Read the report again and confirm the figure it gives.

data.name: AccountStatusUnknown
data.value: This account status is not one the panel knows. Use active or suspended.

data.name: PlanFeatureUnknown
data.value: A plan feature must be one of the features the panel lists.

data.name: ResellerNotFound
data.value: This reseller could not be found.

data.name: ResellerNameTaken
data.value: This name is already used by another reseller or by a hosting account.

data.name: ResellerNameInvalid
data.value: This reseller name is not valid. Use 3 to 30 lowercase letters, digits or underscores, starting with a letter. The reseller signs in with this same name.

data.name: ResellerSuspended
data.value: This reseller is suspended, so it cannot make changes. An administrator has to reactivate it first.

data.name: ResellerHasAccounts
data.value: The reseller was not deleted: it still owns accounts or plans. Delete them first.

data.name: ResellerAccountLimitReached
data.value: The reseller has reached the number of accounts it was sold. Ask an administrator to raise its limit.

data.name: ResellerDiskPoolExceeded
data.value: This would take the reseller past the disk space it was sold. Choose a smaller plan or ask an administrator to enlarge its disk pool.

data.name: ResellerPlanLimitReached
data.value: The reseller has reached the number of plans it was sold. Delete a plan or ask an administrator to raise its limit.

data.name: ResellerPlanExceedsEnvelope
data.value: This plan goes beyond what the reseller was sold: a figure is above its ceiling or a feature is not included. Lower the figures or remove the feature.

data.name: PlanOwnerMismatch
data.value: This plan and this account belong to different owners. An account can only use a plan of its own reseller, and an administrator's account only an administrator's plan.

data.name: ResellerLoginIssuanceFailed
data.value: The reseller was created, but its login could not be issued. Delete the reseller and create it again once the cause in the server log is fixed.

data.name: ResellerEnvelopeInvalid
data.value: The reseller's limits are not valid. Every figure must be zero or more and within the allowed maximum, and every resource ceiling must be positive.
